card.text: GJ 1132 b was found in 2015 by Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "GJ 1132 b"
sources.quote: GJ 1132 b is an exoplanet orbiting GJ 1132, a red dwarf star 41 light-years from Earth, in the constellation Vela.

introduction.text: It is one of 2 planets known around GJ 1132. Its orbit and size follow Xue et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "GJ 1132 b"
sources.quote: The planet is considered uninhabitable but was thought to be cool enough to possess an atmosphere.
